## Pull Request Title Format

Please format your PR title as: `[TICKET ID] TITLE`

**Example:** `[YSEIS-1] Implement User Login`

If it does not have a ticket ID, issue one to Plane.

## Description

Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
